description: Defines classes and types for managing datagram buffers, including a buffer pool and buffer objects, used for efficient socket IO operations in the Chromium project.

classes.name: DatagramBuffer
classes.description: Represents a reusable buffer for datagram data, with methods for setting data and retrieving size.

classes.name: DatagramBufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of datagram buffers, allowing efficient reuse and allocation.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a copy of data to the buffer pool for later reuse.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Returns all buffers to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: max_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of buffers managed by the pool.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the size of the data in the buffer.
